candidate_sql: SELECT r.refund_amt_q1 AS refund_amt_q1, o.gmv_q1 AS gmv_q1, ROUND(r.refund_amt_q1 / o.gmv_q1 * 100, 4) AS refund_rate_pct FROM (SELECT ROUND(SUM(refund_amt), 2) AS refund_amt_q1 FROM refunds WHERE refund_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND refund_dt < '2026-04-01') r CROSS JOIN (SELECT ROUND(SUM(pay_amt), 2) AS gmv_q1 FROM orders WHERE order_status <> 'cancelled' AND order_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND order_dt < '2026-04-01') o
